title: Scope 08 replay classes and the selected-run Safe rerun
note: Paired clean native builds: base 8fdc5e13b1 (the approval-history commit, the rerun's parent after the rebase onto c5f02c476a) and candidate d8c2e3c691 (replay classes and the Safe rerun), each in its own worktree. Standard suite, 7 models, 3 trials, 336/336 successful. Recorded by owner decision although the rerun changes what the model sees only when --resume-run resumes a crashed run with an interrupted Safe call, which this suite never does: the first request's bytes and the tool definitions are identical on every model and scenario. Flagged: claude-opus-5-5 total tokens +3.5% [0.3, 8.1], almost all in shell_then_edit, where two of three candidate trials took one more request and tool call (4 instead of 3); claude-sonnet-5-5 +0.7% [0.2, 1.4], one more tool call in two trials of shell_then_edit and one of unprompted_edit. Both are the model's own path choices over byte-identical requests, not an effect of the change, and are accepted. Failures and tool errors are unchanged or lower.

settings.effort: each route's effort is in routes: medium by default, DeepSeek high (it has no medium), and an EVAL_MODELS @<effort> replaces either

regressionRule: all tasks, per model: total tokens with the 95% interval above zero; requests up more than 10% with the 95% interval above zero; failures +2 or more; any tool-error increase
